In a study comparing the canonical accounts of the *Cariyāpiṭaka* with the Jātaka corpus, André Bareau catalogues the text under the title *Nimi-rāja-Cariyam*, recording it as the sixth story in the collection following *Mahā-Govinda-Cariyam* and preceding *Canda-kumāra-Cariyam* [Bareau, Les récits canoniques].
